import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    n = int(input_data[0])
    p = [int(x) for x in input_data[1:n+1]]
    
    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    q = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    def decompose_cycle(start):
        cycle = []
        curr = start
        while not visited[curr]:
            visited[curr] = True
            cycle.append(curr)
            curr = p[curr - 1]
        return cycle
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if not visited[i]:
            cycle = decompose_cycle(i)
            k = len(cycle)
            
            if k % 2 == 1:
                mid = k // 2
                for j in range(k):
                    next_idx = (j + mid) % k
                    q[cycle[j]] = cycle[next_idx]
            else:
                half = k // 2
                left = []
                right = []
                
                curr = cycle[0]
                for _ in range(half):
                    left.append(curr)
                    curr = p[curr - 1]
                
                curr = cycle[half]
                for _ in range(half):
                    right.append(curr)
                    curr = p[curr - 1]
                
                
                if len(left) != len(right):
                    print("-1")
                    return
                
                
                for idx in range(half):
                    q[left[idx]] = right[(idx + half // 2) % half]
                    q[right[idx]] = left[(idx + half // 2) % half]
    
    result = [str(q[i]) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
    print(" ".join(result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
